description: Which regulations, and which editions, does an answer for a place rest on? Every regulation, guideline or permit table we hold for a place: title, issuer, edition, what it governs, how many rows were read from it, and the source URL and sha256. Use it to say what an answer was searched against.

place.description: ISO 3166 code of where the rule binds: a country (US, CA, DE, FR, IT), a state or province (US-OH, CA-QC), or EU. A place also searches every place above it: US-OH searches US-OH and US; DE searches DE and EU. Omit to search everywhere.
